argv: How many charging bays should we provision for a two-shift operation?

parsed.answer: For a two-shift operation, Acme recommends provisioning one bay for every two robots. [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Dockyard-2 Charging Station > Capacity and Footprint]
